#  Galculator - A GTK(2/3) Based Calculator
Galculator is a simple, Quick to learn calculator built using GTK 2 or GTK 3

## Features
 - Works like a normal calculator
 - Offers a formula entry mode
    - Requires reading of available documentation
 - allows for user defined functions
